newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-ELWOOD FIT TO TACKLE WALES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ELWOOD FIT TO TACKLE WALES.

text.p: Ireland fly-half Eric Elwood has been passed fit to play against Wales in Saturday's Five Nations championship match at Cardiff Arms Park.

Elwood, 27, had been troubled by a hamstring injury picked up while playing for his club Lansdowne in the All-Ireland league at the weekend but he trained on Wednesday morning with the Ireland squad at the University of Limerick grounds.
Ireland have already been forced to make two changes to the original team selected to meet the Welsh.
Denis Hickie, a former Irish schools and under-21 international, will make his Ireland debut on the right wing in the place of James Topping who has been ruled out with a severe bout of 'flu.
Hickie, a 20-year-old student, will be joined by another debutant, Newcastle hooker Ross Nesdale, who was called up on Monday to replace the injured Allen Clarke.
